name: seizures-intellectual disability due to hydroxylysinuria syndrome
description: Seizures-intellectual disability due to hydroxylysinuria syndrome is characterized by hydroxylysinuria, myoclonic and motor seizures and intellectual deficit. It has been described in a brother and sister born to consanguineous parents and in one unrelated patient.
